item.title: Classes & Prototypes in JavaScript
item.description: Back with another archive note! Today we’re digging into Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) in JavaScript. :') If you come from C++ or Java, JavaScript classes look immediately familiar. But under the hood, JavaScript doesn’t have real “traditional” classes at all. Everything runs on a chain of prototypes! Let’s unpack how it works and how the modern class syntax makes our lives ten times easier. The Secret Engine: Prototype Chain In JavaScript, objects have a hidden link to another object called their prototype.
